HOW_TO_PLAY_CONTENT.INTRO: Little Fuck is a card game for 2 or more players. Everyone starts with lives and loses lives when they miss their guesses. The last player still alive wins.
HOW_TO_PLAY_CONTENT.OBJECTIVE: Survive to the end. In each match, guess exactly how many rounds you will win. Miss your guess and you lose lives equal to the size of the miss: guessed 5 but won 2? You lose 3 lives.
HOW_TO_PLAY_CONTENT.CARDS: Card strength decides who wins each round. Before the game starts, the leader picks one of the four card types below in the room options. Common cards of the same value or strength tie with each other.
HOW_TO_PLAY_CONTENT.MATCHES: In the first match each player gets 1 card; in the second, 2; and so on. When the deck is not big enough for everyone, it goes back to 1 card per player.
HOW_TO_PLAY_CONTENT.GUESS: Look at your cards and say how many rounds you think you will win. The last player to guess has one restriction: their guess cannot make the sum of all guesses equal the number of cards in the match.
HOW_TO_PLAY_CONTENT.ROUNDS: In each round, everyone plays one card and the highest card wins the round. If the highest cards tie, nobody scores that round. The winner of a round leads the next one.
HOW_TO_PLAY_CONTENT.SPECIAL: When each player has only 1 card, the match is special: you cannot see your own card, but you can see everyone else's cards. Guess based on your opponents' cards!

CARD_TYPES.NUMBERED: A deck of numbered cards: the higher the number, the stronger the card. By default, there are four cards of each number from 1 to 12, and one of each number from 13 to 16, the strongest cards in the game. In the room options, the leader can customize which numbers are in the game and how many cards of each number there are.
CARD_TYPES.MANILHA_VELHA: A 40-card truco deck (ranks 4 to 7, queens, jacks, kings, aces, 2s and 3s, in all four suits). The manilhas (trump cards) are always the same, from strongest to weakest: the four of clubs (the Zap), the seven of hearts, the ace of spades and the seven of diamonds. After the manilhas, strength goes: 3s, 2s, the other aces, kings, jacks, queens, the remaining 7s, 6s, 5s and the remaining 4s.
CARD_TYPES.MANILHA_NOVA: Card strength is the same as in manilha velha, but the manilhas change every match. At the start of the match, one card is flipped, the same for every player, and stays shown on screen. The manilhas are the cards one level above the flipped card: flip a 2 and the manilhas are the 3s; flip a 3 and the manilhas are the 4s. Among the manilhas, the strongest suit is clubs, then hearts, spades and diamonds.
CARD_TYPES.MANILHA_PARAGUAIA: One card is also flipped at the start of each match, but here the manilhas change every round, repeating a three-round cycle: in the 1st round, the manilhas are one level above the flipped card; in the 2nd round, one level below the flipped card; in the 3rd round, the fixed manilhas of manilha velha apply. From the 4th round on, the cycle starts over. The screen shows the flipped card and which cards are the manilhas of the round.

OPTIONS.CARD_TYPE_MANILHA_VELHA_DESC: Truco deck (40 cards). Manilhas, strongest to weakest: four of clubs (Zap), seven of hearts, ace of spades and seven of diamonds. Then: 3s, 2s, aces, kings, jacks, queens, 7s, 6s, 5s and 4s.
OPTIONS.CARD_TYPE_MANILHA_NOVA_DESC: Same strength as manilha velha, but the manilhas change every match: one card is flipped at the start and the manilhas are the cards one level above it (flipped 2, manilhas are the 3s; flipped 3, manilhas are the 4s). Among manilhas, suits rank clubs, hearts, spades, then diamonds.
OPTIONS.CARD_TYPE_MANILHA_PARAGUAIA_DESC: Also flips one card per match, but the manilhas change every round in a three-round cycle: in the 1st round, one level above the flipped card; in the 2nd, one level below it; in the 3rd, the fixed manilha velha manilhas. The cycle repeats in the following rounds.
OPTIONS.CARD_TYPE_NUMBERED_DESC: Numbered cards: the higher the number, the stronger the card. Cards 13 to 16 are the strongest, and cards of the same value tie.
OPTIONS.CARDS_FEWER_THAN_PLAYERS: Danger: there are only {cards} card(s) for {players} players. Cards with value 1 will be added automatically until there is at least one card per player.
OPTIONS.CARD_COUNT: Number of cards of this strength
OPTIONS.POWERUPS_TIMING_MATCH: At the start of every match
OPTIONS.POWERUPS_TIMING_GAME: Only at the start of the game
